…and very close to them we have Nick Head (Javelin), Derek Wade (Long Jump), Brian King (Javelin), Frank Glass (Discus), Bob Couillault (Triple Jump), Denzil Winsborrow (Pole Vault and High Jump) and Barry Townsend (High Jump and Pole Vault).…
Our first reserve in this event would be a difficult choice between Bob Couillault, Arnold Bent, Barry Townsend, George Borkowski and Denzil Winsborrow all with distances around 21 feet.
We had our share of victories, gaining first, second and third places in the high jump, a Nick Head win in the javelin(as usual) and Bob Couillault's double in the long and triple jumps.

John Thresher running his first track race over 1500 metres produced a time equivalent to a 4.08 mile and showed great promise for the coming season. Encouraging performances were also shown by Denzil Winsborrow and Bob Couillault who both did sub-60 seconds in the 440 hurdles.

Arnold Bent repeated his Sen/Jnr high jump double of last year and Bob Couillault clinched a useful triple/long jump double. Carl Lawton had a stylish win in the 2 miles walk after a fast start by Brian Ward that suggested an upset was due.
4 x 110 · 1. · Belgrave H. (D. Winsborrow, R. Couillault, A. Brooks, C. Martin) · 45.3
Adrian Major ran the mile and 3 miles, Tony Brooks the half mile,triple jump and both relays, Denzil Winsborrow 3 events and Bob Couillault 3 events.
There were other good performances by Nick Head (Javelin and Discus), Bob Couillault (Triple), new member Robertson (Hammer), Tony Brooks (400) and Peter Hilliar (800).
Our best performances came from John Thresher and Geoff North in the 1500, Derek Glendinning and Bob Couillault in the Triple Jump and our "B" string sprinters Steve White and Chris Martin.

His win, is a just reward of some solid work over the last year. Turning to the field, Bob Couillault surpassed himself with a 5' 8" high jump - we knew he'd done it in training, but didn't believe him!
110m H: An unexpectedly good run from Bob Couillault just back from holiday. 400m H: But for hitting the last hurdle, Charles Gillett must have beaten his best.

Our winners were Bruno Hafner ('B' 100 metres), Lionel Mann ('B' 5000 metres), Alan Black ('B' steeplechase), Charlie Gillett ('B' 400 metres hurdles), Arnold Bentt ('A' High Jump), Bob Couillault ('B' Triple Jump) and the 4 x 100 metres relay team of Lee Sullivan, Bruno Hafner, Charlie Gillett and Steve White.
